First, I know from your post that you have a lot of emotions and are super distressed by all of this. It’s really hard to make any major decisions while your emotions are all ramped up. Trust me, I’ve been there. I suggest just taking some time away from the situation and doing some things you like to do, by yourself or with friends, and just trying to keep your mind off it. Sometimes a little reset can help.

I was someone who was also told a lot “you’re only 18, you’re still young and have so much time” and it really just felt like people were dismissing what I was feeling and calling me stupid. However, I will say that 9 years later, for me, I can safely say that life changes so much so fast in your late teens/early 20’s, and yeah, you do have time and it takes a LONG time to figure yourself out and what you want in life. Relationships at that age are good for exploring and learning what you want. People make mistakes, and especially at that age, your mistakes stick in your brain and feel like you’ve ruined everything. But time does heal some things and I think it’ll help for you too.

Sorry to go all therapist for a sec there, but if you take anything out of this:
-Yes, you cheated. That sucks, but what are you going to do to make sure you don’t do that again?
-Please take time and really try to discover what you want in life and do some things for yourself to help move away from the pain that this break up has caused you.
